name: RP1
summary: A full-stack open-source biped from Shanghai's RoboParty (founded February 2025), unveiled at IROS 2026 with balance-recovery demos and peak joint torque up to 160 N·m. It succeeds the ROBOTO ORIGIN prototype, whose GitHub repository drew more than 2,500 stars; a broader release of hardware and motion policies is planned for Q4 2026.

sources.title: RoboParty Unveils RP1 Humanoid at IROS — Humanoids Daily
